title: Phrasal verbs 8 up (2)
subtitle: bring up, come up with, make up, look up, put up with, split up…

items: bring up a topic — поднять тему; come up — всплыть в разговоре.
come up with an idea — придумать, предложить.

theory.text: «Терпеть шум» — put up with the noise: оба слова, up и with, обязательны, и местоимение идёт в конце: I can't put up with it. А вот в look it up, make it up местоимение стоит в середине.

items.ru: Пожалуйста, не поднимай эту тему за ужином.
en: Please don't bring this up at dinner.
Please don't bring up this topic at dinner.
Please don't bring that up at dinner.

items.ru: Вопрос о деньгах всплыл на собрании.
en: The question of money came up at the meeting.
The question of money came up in the meeting.
Who came up with this idea?
Who came up with that idea?
We need to come up with a plan.

That isn't true, you made it all up.
It's not true, you made it all up.
Don't make up excuses.
Don't make excuses up.
We're saving up for a new car.

items.ru: Лора копит деньги, чтобы поехать в Японию.
en: Laura is saving up to go to Japan.
Laura is saving up for a trip to Japan.

items.ru: Он порвал фотографию на мелкие кусочки.
en: He tore up the photo.
He tore the photo up.
He tore the photo into small pieces.

items.ru: Джек и Мэри расстались в прошлом месяце.
en: Jack and Mary split up last month.
Jack and Mary broke up last month.

items.ru: Они купили старый дом и отремонтировали его.
en: They bought an old house and did it up.

items.ru: Если не знаешь слово, посмотри его в словаре.
en: If you don't know a word, look it up in a dictionary.
If you don't know the word, look it up in a dictionary.

items.ru: Я посмотрю расписание поездов в интернете.
en: I'll look up the train times online.
I'll look the train times up online.

How do you put up with a neighbor like that?
How can you put up with a neighbour like that?

items.ru: Я больше не могу это терпеть.
en: I can't put up with it any more.
I can't put up with it anymore.
I can't put up with this any more.
Cheer up, everything will be fine!
Cheer up, everything will be OK!
Cheer up, it'll be fine!

items.ru: Давай купим ей цветы, чтобы её подбодрить.
en: Let's buy her flowers to cheer her up.

items.ru: Двое мужчин избили его возле бара.
en: Two men beat him up outside the bar.
Two men beat him up near the bar.
Sorry, I was held up at work.

I always mix these twins up.
I always get these twins mixed up.
I always mix up those twins.
